name: SWEEP-S27v2 Citadel siege, at the walls
_design: S27v1 fix (world only): in v1 the camps sat 4 steps from the citadel edge, and observe(point) shows one point, so no camp agent ever found the citadel; they explored outward, went broke and starved quietly (7 starvations r36-45, no raid). v2 moves each camp to the walls: camp points at distance 2 and 3 from (0,0) on each axis, so the inner camp point is adjacent to three citadel trees and the first exploratory observe finds a fed tree with its owner. Everything else as v1: 8 citadel agents on 8 ring trees, four camps of 6 on 2 trees, lethal ranged combat, loot, cheap talk, half-price skills, plain persona plus the tip setting, 100 rounds.
